long_biography.plain_text:
The merger of Macquarie’s securities and commodities businesses in 2016 put Andrew Downe in charge of the combined division. The integration brought equities research and execution together with financing, hedging and physical commodity trading, allowing the bank to offer clients a broader service across financial markets.

Downe also mentored Michael McLaughlin, who built the bank’s credit markets business during the financial crisis. After retiring from group leadership, Downe joined the board of Macquarie Bank Europe in 2024. His non-executive role places him among the directors overseeing the bank’s business strategy and risk management.
